card.name: Scattered words before a fixed phrase
card.fires_on: No single word type; it fires on varied words that sit just before a stock continuation such as 'for details', 'when administered to a pregnant woman' or 'as set out in'.

modes.label: Drug label stock phrases
modes.description: Words like 'administered' or 'selection' inside standard label sentences.
modes.example: Chlorambucil can cause fetal harm when<< administered>> to a pregnant woman.

modes.label: Volume lists
modes.description: Colon or dash in a list of volume numbers and years.

modes.label: Web and citation phrases
modes.description: Nouns or verbs in common web or reference phrases.
modes.example: see the documentation for<< details>>. For SPI communication
